description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Nomura is a global financial services group seeking a Software Engineer to join its GMIT Equity Alpha Development Team. The role involves building and supporting pre-trade applications for equity derivatives, developing innovative tools alongside trading and sales teams, and deploying quantitative libraries in a large-scale distributed environment.
Software Engineer building distributed pre-trade equity derivatives applications for quoting, pricing, and market analysis

Responsibilities:
• The Alpha platform at Nomura is a set of pre-trade applications used globally by the Equity Derivatives Front Office for price discovery, quoting, parameter management & market analysis. The Alpha Development Team is primarily responsible for building & supporting the Alpha platform. We take the highly regarded Quant library and deploy it in a large-scale distributed environment to solve our mass-quoting requirements and provide in-depth analysis and market insight. We are a small, high-performing team and operate in a fast-paced environment, sitting directly on the trading desk
• We are looking for a dynamic software developer to join our team to help us cope with the growing business demand. Working alongside trading & sales, the candidate will work on the Alpha platform and build innovative tools that provide competitive advantage and generate revenue

Requirements:
• Numerate degree holder or above
• Hands-on experience with React, C#, or Java, or any object oriented programming language
• Familiar with SQL database schema, index and stored procedures
• Having strong interest in derivatives and structured products
• A good team player and fast learner

Preferred:
• Web development experience with React
• Experience with C# .NET including LINQ, RX, TPL, WPF, WinForms
• Knowledge with non-SQL database, MongoDB, Redis, etc
• Python 3: Scripting, pandas/numpy, backtesting
